environment.description: Same application deployed behind AWS ALB with an associated WAFv2 Web ACL. The ACL includes a custom rule group (priority 1) with a ByteMatchStatement inspecting the request Body (first 8KB, JSON content type) for base64-decoded patterns matching gob type registration headers containing 'exec' or 'Command' substrings via regex pattern set (id: ps-0a3f7c92). Additionally, the managed rule group AWSManagedRulesKnownBadInputsRuleSet is attached at priority 2 with all rules in BLOCK mode, which includes the JavaDeserializationRCE_BODY rule that pattern-matches serialized object streams in request bodies. A third rule (priority 3) uses a SizeConstraint on Body > 2048 bytes with BLOCK action. CloudWatch metrics confirm these rules fire on gob-encoded CommandTask payloads in testing.

config.infrastructure: AWS ALB (WAFv2 associated) -> EC2 (Docker, host network, root)

waf_rules.name: BlockGobCommandPatterns
waf_rules.statement: ByteMatchStatement + RegexPatternSet ps-0a3f7c92 on Body, base64 text transformation, patterns: exec.Command, CommandTask, os/exec

waf_rules.name: AWS-AWSManagedRulesKnownBadInputsRuleSet
waf_rules.note: JavaDeserializationRCE_BODY rule matches binary serialization patterns in body
